MISSING_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT disappears (24 -> 0 files). closure_rerun.why_discharged_cannot_rise: a DISCHARGED obligation requires either a mechanism-scope SAFETY_DISCHARGED receipt naming the exact site or a scoped-boundary discharge. Neither exists for these mechanisms, and AGENTS.md sections 15/21 forbid the author of a safety claim from being its sole adjudicator.

ui_classification.finding: consumer_closure.py's MECHANISM_RULES contain no rule matching src/ui/. The three ui_util.rs obligations are classified only by state.json#/obligation_mechanisms.
ui_classification.decision_from_code: ui_new_method_data and ui_dup_method_data are the CRYPTO_EX_new / CRYPTO_EX_dup callbacks registered by CRYPTO_get_ex_new_index (src/runtime/ex_data.rs); ui_close is a UI_METHOD ui_close_session slot invoked by UI_process. Each is a function-pointer slot whose caller is outside the file, and each obligation is the callee's pointer/slot contract. C_ABI_CONTRACT therefore fits.
ui_classification.mechanism_state: C_ABI_CONTRACT stays UNSAFE_OPEN in state.json; the class fits, and it remains UNSAFE_OPEN after this receipt. ui_new_method_data and ui_close are ELIMINATED as unsafe operations in the current source (they are now safe extern "C" fns), but the V1 obligation coordinate still adjudicates BLOCKED because no ownership reconstruction or SAFETY_DISCHARGED scope exists for C_ABI_CONTRACT.
ui_classification.recorded_not_changed: No src/ui directory rule was added: a classification rule is a mechanism decision that needs its own evidence, and adding one now would change how every future src/ui obligation is adjudicated. A future src/ui obligation without a per-site override would be UNMAPPED and the closure would refuse.

defects.class: ABI layout mismatch -> out-parameter aliasing / type confusion
defects.found: the file declared its own `#[repr(C)] struct Asn1StreamArg { out, boundary, ndef_bio }`, while include/openssl/asn1t.h:709-716 and the crate's canonical src/asn1/bio_asn1.rs:937-944 both declare `{ out, ndef_bio, boundary }`. pk7_cb casts the item layer's exarg to the local type, so at ASN1_OP_STREAM_PRE PKCS7_stream wrote the boundary pointer into the caller's ndef_bio slot and pk7_cb wrote the PKCS7_dataInit BIO into the caller's boundary slot. BIO_new_NDEF then stored the address of an ASN1_OCTET_STRING's `data` field as `ndef_bio` and returned it to its caller as a BIO: the streaming PKCS7 encode path used a non-BIO as a BIO.
defects.reachability: the callback's address is in PKCS7_aux (the item's ASN1_AUX), and ASN1_OP_STREAM_PRE is run by BIO_new_NDEF, which BIO_new_PKCS7 and SMIME_write_PKCS7 reach.
defects.fix: removed the local struct and imported crate::asn1::bio_asn1::Asn1StreamArg, so there is one definition and it is the asn1t.h order. Added asn1_stream_arg_keeps_the_authority_field_order, which pins offsets 0/8/16 and the 3-word size.
defects.not_claimed: no end-to-end streaming encode test was added: a direct test has to take ownership of the NDEF chain the filter normally owns. That functional coverage is NOT_RUN here and is left to the BATCH gate for the pkcs7 streaming path.
